scope: networked source-free Rocky tool-image preparation only
accepted_controls: Each command streams stdout and stderr directly to exclusive evidence files and atomically records command status.
SIGTERM and SIGINT interrupt the wait, bound client reaping and enter bounded container retirement; uncertain retirement retains the lease.
SIGKILL leaves bytes already emitted and the ownership lease recoverable.
Effective CPUs 2-5, four CPUs, 12 GiB/no additional swap, 512 tasks, private IPC, network and capability controls are inspected before start.
execution_prerequisites: Reverify the exact clean candidate and input manifest immediately before execution.
Require output, evidence and lease targets to be absent and reconcile every conflicting owner.
Require at least 16 GiB host free, 12 GiB scratch free and 16 GiB MemAvailable.
Reconcile pinned base digest e372170ca8630f0f03e9b70fdd0bf4a3ce3426b0de7cdba615f06337389de176 with local image ID sha256:0b5329d806d053ad65ab6b21fc3e49f1025e970cd826547a01a93b3ce9012796.

checkpoint_state.reason: The launcher requested an immediate checkpoint after review completion; the released command is preserved as the next executable task.

limitations: This is only a technical release for the exact preparation boundary. It grants no offline build, module, guest, runtime, production-package or OS acceptance.
